name: ableton-live-mcp
description: Control Ableton Live from Claude: the whole Live Object Model, music generators, mixing and audio analysis.
long_description:
Talks to Ableton Live through a MIDI Remote Script, which the server copies into Live's User Library the first time it starts. In Live, pick **AbletonMCP** under Settings → Link, Tempo & MIDI → Control Surface, then ask Claude to look at your set.

- Mixer, routing, tracks, scenes, clips, notes and automation, plus generic access to everything in the Live Object Model
- Chord progressions, drum grooves, basslines, arpeggios, melodies, Euclidean rhythms, Live 12's MIDI Tools, Turkish makams and usuls
- Listening: renders a section and measures loudness, true peak, tonal balance and stereo; mix doctor, stems, reference matching, snapshots with A/B
- Interactive panels (mixer, meters, piano roll, drum pads, reference curve) in clients that support MCP Apps

Everything stays on your computer: the server only connects to Live on 127.0.0.1. Unofficial; not affiliated with Ableton.

profile.title: Tool set
profile.description: core: one tool per job (recommended). full: also the original tools that newer ones replace, for prompts written against them.
